rules i follow to keep my
brain calm and sharp

no phone in bed

my phone charges in the kitchen, never next to my bed. the last and first minutes of the day became mine again, and my sleep improved noticeably within just a week.

one thing at a time

i never eat, work and scroll at the same time anymore. doing one thing fully made me calmer and, strangely, much faster at almost everything i do each day.

a lesson before news

i learn one small thing before i read any news: a painting, a myth, a planet. starting with wonder instead of worry changes the tone of my whole morning.

a lesson before news

i learn one small thing before reading any news: a painting, a myth. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and starting with wonder instead of worry changed my mornings.

slides.texte_overlay:
walk without input

i walk twenty minutes a day with no headphones. my brain uses that quiet to sort through everything, and that's usually when i solve the problems i was stuck on all day.

write it down

i write every worry on paper before bed. once it's on the page, my brain stops replaying it, and i fall asleep far faster than when i keep it all inside.
